_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 30d momentum near 50 and unchanged price define a coil; no breaker yet moves fear_greed or momentum out of the Hope band.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both imply no immediate directional chase; analyst explicit HOLD/Hope, narrative flow story is cautionary but not a phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound with 30d momentum near 50 and fear_greed inside 63-70
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break pushes momentum outside 40-60 and fear_greed outside 63-70 (down on expanding inflows or up on squeeze clearing skew/CVD)
